```{r}
# for example
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

n_before_1 <- 5415
n_before_2 <- 8123

n_after_1 <- 1432
n_after_2 <- 7543

my_table <- tibble(
  cell_ID = c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2),
  treated = c(treated_1,treated_2),
  num_cells_before = c(n_before_1,n_before_2),
  bun_cells_after = c(n_after_1,n_after_2)
)
gt(my_table)
```
